dating: index 0 = 2026Q3, the state measured on data to September 2026; index 1 = 2026Q4, the first simulated quarter; index 9 = 2028Q4; index 24 = 2032Q3 (decision 43)

bust.path: the 2000-02 bust, measured (global_crash.bust_2000), from the quarter of the peak

piece_by_piece.note: each row takes one piece of the case (at its high end) back to the model's central setting; 'adds' is the case minus that run, the difference of the unrounded runs rounded once: at 2028Q4, at 2032Q2, and at the peak (2032Q3 while still rising)

sensitivities.note: each changes one setting the case does not carry, on the case at its high end; at the peak and at 2032Q2

alternatives.note: each changes the bust (or switches decision 27's energy term on), on the case at its high end; paths for the watcher's vocabulary, not scored
